title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Trial of Cases by Circuit Courts

articles.content_en:
Article 1 The Supreme People's Court shall establish circuit courts to accept and hear relevant cases within the circuit areas. The First Circuit Court is located in Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province, with the circuit area covering the four provinces and regions of Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, and Hunan. The Second Circuit Court is located in Shenyang City, Liaoning Province, with the circuit area covering the three provinces of Liaoning, Jilin, and Heilongjiang. The Third Circuit Court is located in Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province, with the circuit area covering the five provinces and municipalities of Jiangsu, Shanghai, Zhejiang, Fujian, and Jiangxi. The Fourth Circuit Court is located in Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, with the circuit area covering the four provinces of Henan, Shanxi, Hubei, and Anhui. The Fifth Circuit Court is located in Chongqing, with the circuit area covering the five provinces and regions of Chongqing, Sichuan, Guizhou, Yunnan, and Tibet. The Sixth Circuit Court is located in Xi'an City, Shaanxi Province, with the circuit area covering the five provinces and regions of Shaanxi, Gansu, Qinghai, Ningxia, and Xinjiang. The headquarters of the Supreme People's Court directly accepts relevant cases from the five provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities of Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei, Shandong, and Inner Mongolia.
The Supreme People's Court may, in accordance with relevant provisions and the needs of adjudication work, add circuit courts and adjust the circuit areas and case acceptance scopes of circuit courts.

Article 2 A circuit court is a permanent adjudication institution dispatched by the Supreme People's Court. The judgments, rulings, and decisions made by a circuit court are the judgments, rulings, and decisions of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 4 Cases of intellectual property, foreign-related commerce, maritime affairs and maritime commerce, death penalty review, state compensation, enforcement, and cases protested by the Supreme People's Procuratorate shall, for the time being, be adjudicated or handled by the headquarters of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 5 A circuit court shall establish a litigation service center to accept and register case materials falling within the circuit court's scope of case acceptance and provide litigation services to the parties. Where a party requests the circuit court to forward materials of cases that shall, in accordance with these Provisions, be accepted by the headquarters of the Supreme People's Court, the circuit court shall forward them.
A circuit court shall, for cases meeting the case-filing conditions, uniformly number and file the cases on the case handling information platform of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 6 Where a party appeals against a first-instance administrative or civil and commercial judgment or ruling made by a Higher People's Court within the circuit area, the statement of appeal shall be submitted to the circuit court through the original trial People's Court. Where a party directly appeals to the circuit court, the circuit court shall, within five days, transfer the statement of appeal to the original trial People's Court. The original trial People's Court shall, within five days of receiving the statement of appeal and the statement of defense, submit them to the circuit court together with all case files and evidence.

Article 7 Where a party applies for retrial or files a petition against a legally effective judgment or ruling made by a Higher People's Court within the circuit area, the party shall submit to the circuit court materials such as a written application for retrial or a written petition.

Article 8 Where the Supreme People's Court considers that a case accepted by a circuit court has significant guiding significance for the uniform application of law, it may decide to have the case adjudicated by its headquarters.
Where a circuit court considers that an already accepted case has significant guiding significance for the uniform application of law, it may report to the headquarters of the Supreme People's Court for adjudication.
Article 9 A circuit court may, according to the needs of adjudication work, hear cases on circuit and receive visits within the circuit area.

Article 10 A circuit court shall, in accordance with the principles of letting adjudicators adjudicate and holding adjudicators responsible, implement the case handling responsibility system of principal judges and collegiate benches. The principal judges of a circuit court shall be selected by the Supreme People's Court from among adjudicators with outstanding case handling ability and rich adjudication experience. The collegiate benches of a circuit court shall be composed of principal judges.

Article 11 The chief judge and deputy chief judges of a circuit court shall participate in collegiate bench adjudication of cases. When a collegiate bench adjudicates a case, the principal judge handling the case shall serve as the presiding judge. When the chief judge or a deputy chief judge participates in a collegiate bench to adjudicate a case, he or she shall serve as the presiding judge. Judgments and rulings made by a circuit court shall, after being signed by the members of the collegiate bench, be issued by the presiding judge.

Article 12 Cases accepted by a circuit court shall be uniformly incorporated into the comprehensive adjudication information management platform of the Supreme People's Court for management, and case-filing information, adjudication procedures, and adjudication documents shall be disclosed to the parties and the public according to law.

Article 13 A circuit court shall have integrity supervisors responsible for the daily integrity supervision of the circuit court.
The Supervision Bureau of the Supreme People's Court shall exercise integrity supervision over circuit courts and their staff by accepting reports and complaints, investigating and handling disciplinary violation cases, and conducting judicial inspections and adjudication affairs supervision.
